logline: Los Angeles defence attorney Mickey Haller conducts his entire practice from the back of a Lincoln Navigator, taking on increasingly complex criminal cases while managing a complicated personal life and sobriety.

renewal.note: A fifth and confirmed final season was ordered on January 28, 2026. Season 4 debuted February 5, 2026. The show is adapted from Michael Connelly's Mickey Haller novel series.

bollymeter.basis: 79% on Rotten Tomatoes from 34 critics; a competent and watchable procedural let down by comparisons to the 2011 Matthew McConaughey film, though Manuel Garcia-Rulfo's lead performance earned consistent praise.

pull_quotes.text: It's pretty good and frequently satisfying.
No objection here if Netflix wants to provide a well-acted throwback series with likable anti-heroes and colorful suspects.

seasons.review_body: Season 1 premiered May 13, 2022, adapting Michael Connelly's second Haller novel, The Brass Verdict. Manuel Garcia-Rulfo stepped into the role McConaughey had played in the 2011 film, which many critics used as an unavoidable reference point. The 79-percent Rotten Tomatoes score from 34 reviews reflected qualified approval: the Chicago Tribune called it frequently satisfying, the Chicago Sun-Times positioned it as a well-executed throwback. Critics found Garcia-Rulfo's relaxed authority in the lead an underrated asset. The criticisms clustered around pacing in the middle episodes and a narrative that rarely surprised in its procedural beats. Audiences responded well - an IMDb average above 7.8 reflected viewer enjoyment of the format's reliability.

bollymeter.basis: 91% on Rotten Tomatoes from 11 critics; a clear quality step up from Season 1 with a tighter case structure and better deployment of the supporting ensemble, though the small sample limits confidence.

pull_quotes.text: It's an old-school type of television show. And its formula, cleverly updated and executed, still works.

seasons.review_body: Season 2 split into two five-episode parts, with Part 1 dropping July 6 and Part 2 on August 3, 2023. It adapted The Lincoln Lawyer novel directly, giving Mickey a more personal case and tightening the procedural structure. The 91-percent Rotten Tomatoes score from 11 critics - a small sample but uniformly positive - reflected a qualitative improvement over Season 1. RogerEbert.com captured the consensus: an old-school television formula, cleverly updated, that still works. KDHX noted Garcia-Rulfo's consistent deployment of charm and perceptive intelligence. The split-part release generated anticipation effectively, and the season confirmed the show was finding its voice rather than simply executing a proven template.
seasons.season_over_season: Tighter narrative and a more personal central case lift Season 2 measurably over the debut season; the 91% critical score reflects genuine improvement.

bollymeter.basis: 100% on Rotten Tomatoes from 11 critics; the series' best-reviewed season to date, with critics praising Connelly's trademark revelation structure and the show's growing confidence in its cast.

pull_quotes.text: It's a dense, compelling story, full of Connelly's characteristic revelations and cliffhangers.

seasons.review_body: Season 3 premiered October 17, 2024, and earned a perfect 100 percent on Rotten Tomatoes from 11 critics - the series' highest mark. The Australian called it dense and compelling, full of Connelly's trademark revelation structure and cliffhangers that keep cases feeling genuinely suspenseful. The Age noted that the show had settled into a confident rhythm: it knows exactly what it wants to be and mostly delivers. Three seasons in, the writing room understood the Haller voice and the supporting ensemble had been given material that let them develop alongside the lead. For procedural drama, a perfect critical score at Season 3 represents a show finding its optimal form. The sample size remained small, but the unanimity was real.
seasons.season_over_season: The show's creative ceiling: dense Connelly plotting, confident ensemble work, and a perfect critical score after two seasons of steady improvement.

seasons.review_body: Season 4 debuted February 5, 2026, with the penultimate season before the confirmed final Season 5. Early critical reception has held at fresh. The season continues the Haller formula with the show now in its most confident phase creatively. A full critical sample and verdict are pending as the season remains recent at time of authoring.
seasons.season_over_season: Penultimate season ahead of the confirmed final run; early critical reception holds the series' fresh run.
